entry_title: First SETI Survey Using ALMA: High-Frequency Technosignature Search at 90–93 GHz
meta_pattern_description: SETI's 50-year fixation on the 1.42–1.66 GHz 'water hole' represents a cognitive attractor. Mason's ALMA survey deliberately breaks this symmetry by shifting to mm/submm wavelengths where RFI is negligible, ISM scattering is absent, and interferometric baseline suppression eliminates terrestrial false positives. The 'bycatch' methodology reveals every pointing is a de facto wide-field survey, with Gaia-based estimates underestimating true stellar coverage by ~21×.

content_summary.what: First technosignature survey using archival ALMA data in Band 3 (90.642 GHz and 93.151 GHz), searching for narrowband radio signals from 28 galactic stars selected from Gaia DR3.
content_summary.how: Analysed existing ALMA calibrator observations (not new pointings). Employed stellar 'bycatch' method using Besançon Galactic Model (BGM) to estimate full stellar population within undistorted interferometric field of view.
content_summary.result: No candidate technosignatures above detection thresholds. Minimum EIRP > 6.91×10¹⁷ W for closest star in sample. Demonstrated ALMA's viability for high-frequency SETI.
content_summary.significance: Expands SETI parameter space to mm/submm wavelengths where no prior searches existed. Bycatch analysis shows previous surveys sampled ~21× more stars than catalog-based estimates suggest.

cluster_mapping.rationale: Interferometric baseline correlation (ALMA) as macroscopic analog of quantum interference; measurement basis selection (frequency band) as observer-dependent parameter space partitioning.
Narrowband signal detection as information-theoretic filter; RFI suppression as decoherence mitigation; bycatch as implicit channel capacity expansion.
Interferometric array geometry (50+ 12m antennas) creates topological aperture synthesis; phase closure relations invariant under individual antenna failure.
Bycatch paradigm as direct analog of SNN focality: single 'pointing' captures latent structure far beyond nominal target. VETO gate principle: reject dominant mode, amplify background.

c9_notes.continuity: User's Dec 2023 '7/10' artificiality rating for 3I/ATLAS sits in productive tension with this formal null result at 90 GHz. The ALMA methodology (archival + bycatch) could in principle be applied to interstellar objects.
c9_notes.actionable: Mason et al. (2026) bycatch paper provides public BGM calculator. Could integrate into TNG validation suite as stellar population prior for halo-targeted SETI — bridging cosmological Assembly Index with technosignature prevalence constraints.
c9_notes.discovery_pipeline_relevance: High — expands observable parameter space for A_c technosignature detection beyond traditional water hole.
